signals.signal: AFIR alternative-fuels data is required in structured formats including DATEX II, while physical charger, OCPP, CPMS, OCPI, NAP and map representations can disagree.
signals.implication: ChargeTruth is an observability/reconciliation wedge; generic AFIR export is absorbed.

signals.signal: Regulation (EU) 2026/1738 requires electronic destruction certificates, cross-border recognition, registration cancellation after certificate receipt, and electronic VIN/roadworthiness checks for used-vehicle export.
signals.implication: VINState can test impossible lifecycle combinations before sale/export/dismantling; a VIN-history report is rejected.

signals.signal: Directive (EU) 2024/3019 requires producers responsible for micropollution to fund at least 80% of additional quaternary-treatment costs through EPR schemes.
signals.implication: MicroFee should explain product-level allocation and disputes; generic wastewater reporting is rejected.

signals.signal: The Commission’s July 2026 NZIA guidance applies non-price criteria in renewable auctions, including cybersecurity, delivery capability, sustainability and resilience.
signals.implication: BidProof can tie supplier evidence to auction score/economic impact; generic NZIA checklists are rejected.

signals.signal: F-gas restrictions distinguish virgin, recycled and reclaimed gases and make equipment, batch, jurisdiction, technician and service context material to a lawful service decision.
signals.implication: ReclaimRight is an eligibility gate; generic refrigerant tracking is rejected.

signals.signal: Euro 7 aftermarket sale/installation conditions create a vehicle-part-approval-date-jurisdiction fitment problem beyond physical compatibility.
signals.implication: PartGate is a narrow legal-fitment gate; generic parts catalogues are alternatives.

signals.signal: ESAP uses an issuer → collection body → ESAP chain with metadata, validation, API and electronic-seal requirements.
signals.implication: ESAP Relay should own receipt-chain reconciliation; filing generation is a feature and ESAP Preview merges into it.

signals.signal: Age-verification systems can be individually compliant while failing across privacy, bypass resistance, interoperability and user-experience conditions.
signals.implication: AgeProof Lab is an adversarial test network, not another identity provider; demand and legal scope remain unproven.

signals.signal: Cross-border EV charging combines roaming, tax place-of-supply, tariff, session and settlement records.
signals.implication: ChargeTax remains deep validation only; tax engines and roaming platforms are strong alternatives.

signals.signal: ReFuelEU creates fuel-attribute and reporting chains across suppliers, operators, uplift records and EASA reporting.
signals.implication: UpliftMirror remains deep validation; SAF claim and carbon-accounting suites are strong alternatives.

signals.signal: Agentic commerce adds human intent, agent interpretation, merchant state, payment authorization and fulfilled-product states that can diverge.
signals.implication: IntentReplay is a dispute-replay hypothesis; generic identity/payment layers are rejected.

signals.signal: The corpus already contains direct or adjacent records for MicroFee, connected-vehicle origin, BidTwin/AuctionProof, ReclaimProof, Euro 7 consistency, AFIR checkout assurance, and wastewater cost challenge.
signals.implication: Continuation decisions should be MERGE/RESEARCH_MORE, not new canonical promotion.
